title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 7, section 40 (Norbury Lake Park)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 7 No Hunting Areas (Section 8)
Norbury Lake Park
40 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in M.U. 4-22 being all Crown land in Kootenay Land District described as: Sublots 1 and 8 of District Lot 318, the whole containing 97 hectares, more or less. [en. B.C. Reg. 204/91, s. 13; am. B.C. Reg. 151/2006, s. 5 (a).]
